title: Vodoča Monastery (St. Leontius)
description: Approximate stub for the monastery of Saint Leontius near Strumica. Dev Content still has to confirm the pin and the English copy.
longDescription: Fallback only. On current main, src/data/spots.ts already contains Vodoča Monastery, and the seed uses that row. These coordinates are the spec's approximate pin and are not what gets loaded when the slug already exists.
poeticTagline: Where the eastern loop keeps a quiet hour
riderTips: Pair it with Kolesino and Smolare rather than riding it as its own day
Modest dress is expected in the church
